text:
Maria G.: Quick UX spike — the in-product docs dock is inconsistent with the Console nav. On the nav it’s labelled `Help`, inside the dock header it says `Docs`, and the CTA uses `Open docs` elsewhere. Feels confusing for new users.
Shawn K.: Yep noticed that too. Users ask where to find Tutorials vs API reference. What's the canonical term we want? `Docs` or `Help`?
Ava (design): I'd vote for `Docs` (short and matches external site). But we should surface friendlier labels where appropriate, e.g., `Examples & guides` in the landing state.
Eli R.: From instrumentation POV we have metrics tagged both help_panel_open and docs_dock_open — we should consolidate event names if copy changes. Can someone own the migration plan?
docs-bot: New doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/help-lexicon — authored by @Ava (design) :page_with_curl:
Maria G.: thanks. Also accessibility nit: screen reader reads the dock header as "Panel" because theres no aria-label on the toggle. Proposed snippet:
```
<button aria-label="Open docs panel" id="docs-toggle">Docs</button>
```
Shawn K.: good call. Also the crosslink behavior: clicking internal anchors currently opens the external docs in a new tab but doesn't focus the dock. Users expect the dock to open to that exact section. Can we change to deep-link into the dock when the model is present, fallback to new tab otherwise?
Ava (design): I sketched two flows: 1) deep link -> open dock -> scroll to anchor, 2) external fallback -> new tab. I'll drop screenshots in the doc.
Eli R.: Implementation note: we can capture the anchor fragment (#batching-config) and call dock.open({anchor}) then emit analytics with anchor param. That avoids routing the whole page. Will add a small feature flag.
Maria G.: For microcopy — suggest changing CTA from `Open docs` to `Open docs in side panel` when in-console, and keep `View docs` for external links. Shorter but clearer.
Shawn K.: +1. Also update modal headings: "Docs" -> "Console docs" for clarity in multi-tab flows.
Ava (design): I'll update the copy deck and the Figma frames. PR incoming.
Eli R.: I'll add tests: telemetry consolidated, anchor deep-links exercised, and a11y aria-label check.
Maria G.: Awesome. Can we land a tiny RFC in #product-ship by Friday with owners for copy, infra, and analytics?
Shawn K.: I'll own the RFC. tagging @Ava @Eli.
Ava (design): noted.
Eli R.: noted.
Maria G.: thanks team :thumbsup:
